Study of Local Administration of Hemostatic Gel in Canine Epistaxis (SOLACE)
Open
Summary of Study: The trial aims to evaluate the tolerability and adverse event profile of hemostatic gel in the setting of canine epistaxis of any cause. With this, we also are studying the potential hemostatic activity of hemostatic gel in canine epistaxis. Canine epistaxis was found to be a result from a variety of causes, including trauma, foreign bodies, infections, coagulopathies,
Study Details
Stratification of Outcomes for Lymphoma In Dogs with Relapsed Lymphoma (SOLID-Relapse)
Open
Summary of Study: The Stratification of Outcomes for Lymphoma In Dogs with Relapsed Lymphoma (SOLID-Relapse) study is a clinical trial focused on the follow- up of dogs previously enrolled in Ethos-SOLID. This population of relapsed patients will add the perspective of longitudinal analysis and provide a unique opportunity to study the role of functional precision medicine in treatment of relapsed lymphoma.

Biobanking Osteosarcoma as a Nexus for Evaluation and Staging (BONES)

Advancing bone cancer research in dogs through Osteosarcoma Summary of Study Osteosarcoma is the most prevalent form of bone cancer in dogs, sharing many biological similarities with the disease in humans. PREDICT: Biomarkers to predict response to treatment of Protein Losing Nephropathy (PLN)
Closed
Investigating predictive biomarkers in response to treatment of kidney disease Goal: Investigate whether biomarker RNA profiles can predict response to AR blockers for proteinuria in dogs with PLN. Feline Idiopathic Cystitis Study
Closed
FICUSS Study Study Goals: FICUSS Study looks to improve understanding of Feline Idiopathic Cystitis. The collected samples will be used to help better understand the underlying pathophysiology of this disease, which can then be used to aid in the development of novel diagnostic tests and targeted therapies for this condition. Minimally Invasive Metastasectomy in Canines (MIMIC)
Open
Minimally-invasive surgical bone cancer treatment for dogs CURRENTLY ENROLLING The MIMIC clinical trial is open for enrollment. Ethos Discovery is investigating a new minimally-invasive surgical treatment for canine osteosarcoma that has metastasized, or spread, to the lungs.
